The Bixby Center for Global Reproductive Health and Policy at the University of California, San Francisco, is a leading institution in reproductive sciences, located in San Francisco, California. 2. Dr. Rintaro Mori serves as the Director of the Department of Health Policy at the National Research Institute for Child Health and Development in Tokyo, Japan. 3. Professor James Neilson, who chaired the May 2017 consultation, is the Coordinating Editor of the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Group and a Professor at the University of Liverpool in the United Kingdom. 4. Hiromi Obara is a Health Policy Advisor for the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) in Vientiane, Lao People’s Democratic Republic. 5. Professor Oladapo Olayemi is the Head of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at the College of Medicine, University of Ibadan, Nigeria. 6. Professor Robert Pattinson is the Director of the Maternal and Infant Health Care Strategies Unit at the South African Medical Research Council/University of Pretoria (SAMRC/UP) based at Kalafong Hospital in Pretoria, South Africa. 7. Dr. Harshad Sanghvi is the Chief Medical Officer at Jhpiego, an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, located in Baltimore, Maryland, USA. 8. Dr. Mandisa Singata-Madliki is the Deputy Director of the Effective Care Research Unit at East London Hospital Complex, University of Fort Hare, South Africa. 9. Professor Jorge E. Tolosa is a specialist in Obstetrics and Gynecology, coordinating the Global Network for Perinatal and Reproductive Health (GNPRH) and affiliated with Oregon Health & Science University in Portland, Oregon, USA, as well as the Universidad de Antioquia in Medellín, Colombia. 10. Professor Hayfaa Wahabi is the Chair of Evidence-Based Healthcare and Knowledge Translation at the College of Medicine, King Saud University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 11. Blami Dao is the Technical Director for Western and Central Africa at Jhpiego, an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, Maryland, USA. 12. Professor G. Justus Hofmeyr is affiliated with the Effective Care Research Unit at the Universities of Witwatersrand and Fort Hare, as well as the Eastern Cape Department of Health in East London, South Africa. 13. Professor Caroline Homer is the Director of the Centre for Midwifery, Child, and Family Health at the University of Technology, Sydney, Australia. 14. Professor Vanora Hundley is based at the Centre for Midwifery, Maternal, and Perinatal Health at Bournemouth University, United Kingdom. 15. Barbara Levy is the Vice President of Health Policy at the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists in Washington, D.C., USA. 16. Professor Ashraf Nabhan is a faculty member in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt. 17. Edgardo Abalos is the Vice Director of the Centro Rosarino de Estudios Perinatales in Rosario, Argentina. 18. Professor Debra Bick specializes in Evidence-Based Midwifery Practice at the Florence Nightingale Faculty of Nursing and Midwifery, King’s College London, United Kingdom. 19. Meghan Bohren is a consultant in the Department of Reproductive Health and Research at the World Health Organization in Geneva, Switzerland. 20. Dr. Monica Chamillard and Dr. Virginia Diaz are medical doctors at the Centro Rosarino de Estudios Perinatales in Rosario, Argentina. 21. Professor Soo Downe is a specialist in Midwifery Studies at the University of Central Lancashire, United Kingdom. 22. Therese Dowswell is a Research Associate with the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Group at the University of Liverpool, United Kingdom. 23. Kenneth Finlayson is a Senior Research Assistant in Midwifery Studies at the University of Central Lancashire, United Kingdom. 24. Frances Kellie is the Managing Editor of the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Group at the University of Liverpool, United Kingdom. 25. Dr. Theresa Lawrie is a consultant in Evidence-Based Medicine Consultancy Ltd, based in Bath, United Kingdom. 26. Dr. Julia Pasquale is a medical doctor at the Centro Rosarino de Estudios Perinatales in Rosario, Argentina. 27. Dr. Elham Shakibazadeh is an Associate Professor in the Department of Health Education and Promotion at Tehran University of Medical Sciences, Iran. 28. Dr. Gill Thomson is an Associate Professor specializing in Maternal and Infant Nutrition at the University of Central Lancashire, United Kingdom. 29. Diogo Ayres-de-Campos is a member of the FIGO Committee for Safe Motherhood and Newborn Health, affiliated with the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics in London, United Kingdom. 30. Petra ten Hoope-Bender is a Technical Advisor in the Sexual and Reproductive Health Unit at the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) in Geneva, Switzerland. 31. Mechthild M. Gross is the Head of the Midwifery Research and Education Unit at Hannover Medical School, Germany, and a representative of the International Confederation of Midwives. 32. Mary Ellen Stanton is a Senior Reproductive Health Advisor at the Center for Population, Health, and Nutrition, United States Agency for International Development (USAID), Washington, D.C., USA. 33. Alison Wright is the Vice President for UK and Global Membership at the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in London, United Kingdom. 34. Léopold Ouedraogo is the Regional Advisor for Research and Program Development in Reproductive Health at the WHO Regional Office for Africa. 35. Bremen De Mucio is the Regional Advisor for Sexual and Reproductive Health at the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) in Latin America. 36. Karima Gholbzouri is a Medical Officer for Reproductive and Maternal Health at the WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean. 37. Mavjuda Babamuradova is a Medical Officer for Sexual and Reproductive Health at the WHO Regional Office for Europe. 38. Mari Nagai is a Technical Officer for Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child, and Adolescent Health at the WHO Regional Office for the Western Pacific.
